project_type: Flutter mobile app (Dart) with Supabase backend (Postgres + Deno Edge Functions). Spanish-language UI for a non-technical user (Tessa).
language: Dart (Flutter) for the app; TypeScript/Deno for Supabase edge functions; YAML for GitHub Actions; Markdown for docs.
build_system: Flutter SDK (dart/flutter CLI). Deno runtime for edge functions (not installed in sandbox, no test runner in repo). GitHub Actions for CI/CD.
test_framework: flutter test (test/ dir with *_test.dart). No Deno test runner for edge functions.
verification_instructions: Install Flutter stable (not present in sandbox; network is open enough to fetch it from storage.googleapis.com / github). Then from repo root run: 1) flutter pub get, 2) dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed . (must report no changes), 3) flutter analyze (must be 0 issues), 4) flutter test (all green). For the edge function (Deno/TS) there is NO test runner: verify by reasoning through cases (no key, Unsplash success, Pexels fallback, network failure, no results, download-trigger failure) and that it still degrades to {url:null} status 200. Validate workflow YAML syntax (e.g. python3 -c 'import yaml,sys; yaml.safe_load(open(f))' on each workflow file, or a yaml linter).
snapshot_or_generated_files: None relevant. Do NOT add new migrations unless strictly necessary (migrations are immutable; next number would be 0032+). This task should need NO new migration.
setup_instructions: Flutter is not pre-installed. Install Flutter stable via git clone of flutter repo or the flutter-action equivalent, add to PATH, run flutter pub get. Network reachability confirmed: github.com 200, storage.googleapis.com flutter releases 200.
environment_constraints: Network appears OPEN (github, pypi, flutter release storage, api.unsplash.com all reachable). Flutter/Dart/Deno NOT pre-installed on host - must install Flutter to verify Dart changes. Edge functions cannot be executed/tested locally (no Deno, no Supabase stack, no secrets). Workflow changes are published via PR by the orchestrator, never pushed to main directly.
contribution_requirements: Work ON existing branch feat/recetas-rediseno (PR #69, open, not merged). Do NOT create a new branch or PR. Verify with `git branch --show-current` == feat/recetas-rediseno before committing. Commit on top of that branch. Do NOT push, do NOT open a PR (orchestrator handles that). HARD SECURITY RULE: workflow files must NEVER dump the full environment (no `env`, `printenv`, no echoing secrets); reference only the specific secrets needed. Never log secret values.
key_patterns: Edge functions follow Deno.serve + CORS headers + validate JWT via admin.auth.getUser(jwt) + fetch home_id from profiles + read secrets with Deno.env.get. recipe-photo degrades to {url:null} status 200 on any missing-key/provider failure and does NOT consume AI credit. Flutter client (lib/add_recipe_screen.dart _save ~line 475-525, lib/discover_recipes_screen.dart _saveIdea ~line 125-160) calls _client.functions.invoke('recipe-photo', body:{query:title}) and reads ONLY data['url'] (string). The Recipe model (lib/models/recipe.dart) stores external photo URL in externalImageUrl -> column image_url; getter imageUrl prioritizes manual photo (image_path -> bucket) over externalImageUrl. Flutter pitfalls: setState(()=>x=future) with arrow body breaks (use block body); heroTag must be unique on FABs; fromMap must tolerate nulls; empty strings treated as absent.
